title: Spyglass: Now Available to Everyone!
summary: We're thrilled to announce that the powerful Spyglass tool has officially launched, providing everyone with enhanced capabilities and deeper insights.

title: Take Control of Your Files: Enhanced Editor Management
summary: We've empowered you with comprehensive control over your embedded files, allowing for easy management and flexible display options right in the editor.

title: Introducing the Official Product Roadmap
summary: Stay updated on our progress with the new public roadmap, clearly displaying what's been shipped, what's coming next, and what we're planning for the future.

title: Intuitive Checkboxes
summary: We've redesigned our checkboxes to be more intuitive, visually appealing, and effortlessly draggable, making task management smoother than ever.

title: Seamless Team Editing
summary: Experience unparalleled teamwork with our newly refined editor collaboration features, designed to make co-creation more intuitive and efficient.

title: Seamless Shared Item Discovery
summary: Effortlessly find and collaborate on shared content, making teamwork more intuitive and productive than ever before.

title: Global Language Accessibility
summary: Noeko is becoming truly global by introducing comprehensive support for many new languages, empowering a diverse user base.

title: Noeko is Now Open Source!
summary: We've open-sourced Noeko's codebase under the Mozilla Public License, empowering our community with greater control, direct involvement, and full transparency in the project's future.

title: Powerful Filters for Your Visual Knowledge Map
summary: Unlock the full potential of your visual knowledge map with advanced filtering options, making it easier than ever to explore connections, organize information, and kickstart your workflows.

title: Precision Search & Custom Knowledge Views
summary: Empower your knowledge discovery with robust filtering and sorting tools, plus the ability to save your perfectly tailored searches for instant access.

title: Dynamic Content Previews
summary: We're introducing new ways to display linked content, allowing you to better structure and visualize your ideas with dynamic previews and interactive options.

title: Experience Noeko Your Way: Self-Hosted Freedom and Powerful Paid Plans
summary: Empower your team with Noeko's new self-hosting capabilities and flexible paid plans, providing complete control over your data and access to advanced features.

title: Discover Stunning New Themes and Refined Classics
summary: Prepare to personalize your experience with a beautiful refresh of our existing themes and an exciting collection of brand-new, visually stunning options.

title: Enhanced Time-Aware Welcome Messages
summary: We're excited to announce that your homepage greetings will now precisely match the actual time of day, ensuring a consistently delightful and accurate experience.

title: Streamlined Tag Management
summary: Effortlessly manage your tagged content by quickly unapplying tags from multiple items directly within your lists, saving you valuable time.

title: Unlock More Content Sources
summary: Seamlessly integrate a wider array of content, including videos, websites, and text files, to enrich your knowledge base and empower your learning.
